description: Experience the authentic taste of the Middle East with this timeless Classic Hummus recipe, a velvety smooth dip made from chickpeas, tahini, lemon, and garlic. Drizzled with rich olive oil, this homemade delicacy offers a burst of fresh, earthy flavors that will transport your palate to vibrant Mediterranean markets. It is the perfect healthy and satisfying appetizer for any occasion, incredibly easy to prepare from scratch.

ingredients.notes: drained and rinsed, skins removed for extra creaminess (optional)

instructions.title: Prepare Chickpeas
instructions.text: Drain and rinse the canned chickpeas thoroughly under cold water. For an exceptionally smooth hummus, gently rub the chickpeas between your hands to loosen and remove their skins. This step is optional but highly recommended for a truly creamy texture.

instructions.title: Blend Tahini and Lemon
instructions.text: In a food processor, combine the tahini and fresh lemon juice. Process for 1-2 minutes until the mixture becomes smooth, pale, and thick. Scrape down the sides of the bowl to ensure everything is well incorporated.

instructions.title: Add Garlic and Chickpeas
instructions.text: Add the peeled chickpeas, minced garlic, and salt to the tahini mixture in the food processor. Process for 3-5 minutes, scraping down the sides occasionally, until a thick, somewhat grainy paste forms.

instructions.title: Achieve Creaminess with Ice Water
instructions.text: With the food processor running, slowly drizzle in the ice water, 1 tablespoon at a time, until the hummus reaches your desired smooth, light, and creamy consistency. You may need more or less water depending on your tahini and desired texture.

instructions.title: Season and Taste
instructions.text: Add the ground cumin to the hummus and process briefly to combine. Taste the hummus and adjust the seasoning as needed, adding more salt, lemon juice, or cumin to achieve a perfectly balanced flavor profile.

instructions.title: Serve and Garnish
instructions.text: Transfer the finished hummus to a serving bowl. Create a shallow well or swirl on the surface with the back of a spoon. Drizzle generously with extra virgin olive oil, sprinkle with paprika, and garnish with fresh chopped parsley. Serve immediately with warm pita bread, fresh vegetables, or as part of a mezze platter.

tips: For the creamiest hummus, always use good quality tahini and ensure you process it thoroughly with lemon juice first. Removing chickpea skins also makes a big difference.
Using ice water is a secret to light and fluffy hummus. The cold water emulsifies with the tahini and chickpea mixture, creating a wonderfully smooth texture.
Hummus tastes even better after resting for an hour in the refrigerator, allowing the flavors to meld. Store leftovers in an airtight container in the fridge for up to 4-5 days.
